steps.content:
</size=42>The strength of a single person is<color=#fb9259> limited</color> 

That leads one to <color=#fb9259>worry</color>  

To <color=#fb9259>fear</color> 

To <color=#fb9259>think</color> and to <color=#fb9259>retreat</color></size>

<size=42>The strength of a crowd is<color=#fb9259> limitless</color> 

That leads to <color=#fb9259>endless possibilities</color> 

And <color=#fb9259>fearlessness</color>

It emboldens people to do <color=#fb9259>whatever they want without a care</color></size>
Another noisy mob passes by downstairs. They smash and set fire to the abandoned building, destroying everything in sight.
The surging energy in the air stings Hecate's nerves.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Such energy... There must be Sinners around... and quite a few of them, too!
She struggles up and crawls to the window, trying to hear what the crowd is saying.

steps.speaker: Rustfire Member
steps.content: Hahaha, so this is the power of the Sinners! How extraordinary! I can still feel it gushing out on the other end! I'm so excited, I can't wait!

steps.speaker: Rustfire Member
steps.content: With these shackles, all we have to do is to touch ${PlayerName}! If only we knew it was this simple! Why didn't ${PlayerName} give us this power earlier?

steps.speaker: Rustfire Member
steps.content: Why did you wait until you died...

steps.speaker: Rustfire Member
steps.content: Shh, don't talk nonsense. We got this power to avenge him, didn't we? We must exact justice and take back Syndicate! Take back...
steps.female_content: Shh, don't talk nonsense. We got this power to avenge her, didn't we? We must exact justice and take back Syndicate! Take back...

steps.speaker: Rustfire Member
steps.content: Huh... What is this?
A monstrous apparition is floating in mid-air...
It's Nightmare, swelled up to several times its original size, glaring down at the mob below.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Hecate!! What are you doing?! Right now you can't...
The girl stands in the center of Nightmare's palm. Right now, she has forgotten all her pain, and feels only rage and shock.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: ...You have shackles?

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Where did you get them... Where is Chief...

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Answer me!

steps.speaker: Rustfire Member
steps.content: A Sinner? All by herself?

steps.speaker: Rustfire Member
steps.content: Then what are we afraid of?! There are so many of us! Attack!

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Answer me! Where's Chief?!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Hecate!!!

<size=46>Thus they <color=#fb9259>wild</color>

Thus they <color=#fb9259>reckless</color></size>

<size=50><color=#fb9259>Insatiable</color>

And <color=#fb9259>Deviant</color></size>
<size=52>Until they finally <color=#fb9259>cross the line</color></size>
<size=56>And end in <color=#dg1f1f>self-destruction</color></size>
